clean_subset: rows with >=24h follow-up available (recovery24-eligible, non-null baseline_sofa)
exploratory_slices_policy: must be labelled exploratory; may not affect any decision

failure_policy.after_access: incident record; no scientific retry; recompute from saved predictions only

models.CONTROL: V2 recipe refit on the 8,000-subject pool with corrected features (secondary)
models.V2_AS_EVALUATED: frozen V2 models fed pre-split baseline_sofa with nulls preserved (V2 offline harness)
models.V2_AS_SERVED: frozen V2 models fed SOFA(t) for every row (PRIMARY comparator; behaviour of the V2 serving runtime)

promotion_rule.otherwise: retain frozen V2 for that task; mixed bundle allowed per task
promotion_rule.promote_v3_if: paired primary-metric difference favours V3 AND the 98.75% paired CI excludes 0

row_identity: all four models scored on IDENTICAL rows; any eligible-row mismatch is a pipeline investigation, never a row drop
test_access_procedure: score four models on identical rows
